primaryNotice: Two bases: Kotor (Oct 1, 4, 5) and Žabljak (Oct 2, 3). The two coast–north transfer days are not robustly compliant with the 3.5 h ceiling: a current route estimate of 3 h 04 becomes 3 h 41 after the required +20% terrain allowance. Depart only if live routing is at most 2 h 55 and the road is open; otherwise this trip's mandatory north excursion and daily cap cannot both be met in five nights. Tara Bridge is closed throughout these dates.
fallbackNotice: Use this branch if alpine roads, weather, or the adjusted transfer ceiling rule out the north. Kotor remains the base for all five nights; Days 3–5 cover Lovćen/Cetinje, Lake Skadar and the Bay. No high alpine roads are used.

days.afternoon: 15:15–15:30 effective road start after baggage and rental desk. Test-load both checked suitcases and both cabin trolleys beneath the closed parcel cover. Drive to Kotor, check in and unload before any outing.
days.evening: Easy Old Town dinner and a waterfront walk after the flight.
days.parking: Use the hotel’s guarded lot or marked Kotor parking after check-in. Never leave bags in the car.
days.cash: Carry €20–30 in small notes for tips and small purchases.

days.drive: Kotor → Nikšić → Šavnik → Žabljak · route estimates vary; 3 h 04 cited, 3 h 41 adjusted
days.morning: 07:00 depart Kotor after breakfast. This is the long mountain transfer. Before setting off, require live route estimate ≤2 h 55 (≤3 h 30 with terrain uplift), open roads, dry visibility and no frost warning. If that gate fails, do not drive north under this hard cap; switch to the fallback branch.
days.afternoon: Target Žabljak arrival by 11:00–11:30 only if the live route meets the gate. Check in and unload first. If conditions allow, take the short Black Lake loop; leave the trail and parking area by 16:00.
days.evening: Guesthouse dinner in Žabljak; confirm heating, dinner service and guarded parking when booking.
days.parking: Go directly to booked lodging; unload and check in before any park walk. No luggage in a parked car.
days.cash: Carry €20–30/person for park admission and rural purchases; confirm ticket price/payment on site.

days.drive: Local Žabljak–Black Lake–Ćurevac viewpoints · allow 1.5–2.5 h total including uplift
days.morning: Check AMSCG road notices, the official 112 MNE channel and the lodging host for frost, snow, wind and trail status. Walk the Black Lake shore / short marked trail. Use proper footwear and turn back on ice or poor visibility.
days.afternoon: If the access road and weather are confirmed safe, visit the Ćurevac viewpoint for Tara Canyon; finish all highland driving and outdoor activity by 16:00. Do not use the Đurđevića Tara bridge or plan rafting as an October dependency.
days.evening: Early alpine dinner in Žabljak; keep the remainder of the evening close to lodging.
days.parking: Use signed park/Ćurevac parking only; return to the same Žabljak accommodation before dark.
days.cash: Carry cash for park booth, village meals and small parking fees; card acceptance is uncertain.

days.drive: Žabljak → Šavnik → Nikšić → Kotor · route estimates vary; 3 h 04 cited, 3 h 41 adjusted
days.morning: Depart Žabljak by 07:00 in daylight. Check same-day road, weather and visibility reports. Do not route across Đurđevića Tara Bridge, which is closed through Oct 26 at 12:00.
days.afternoon: Drive directly to Kotor. Check in and unload all luggage before any visit. If live estimate exceeds 2 h 55 before uplift or weather deteriorates, stop safely and contact lodging/rental support; the fixed plan has no compliant transfer substitute.
days.evening: Kotor Old Town dinner and a gentle waterfront evening.
days.parking: Book Kotor lodging with guarded parking; unload immediately on arrival. Do not detour with luggage exposed.
days.cash: Keep €20 for fuel/toll contingencies; this route does not require Sozina or the A1.

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Virpazar · about 1 h 12 each way; 2 h 53 adjusted round trip
days.morning: 08:00 depart for Virpazar. Keep hotel luggage secured in Kotor. Take a pre-booked 10:00–12:00 boat only after the operator confirms October service, weather and return time. Be ashore by 15:45 at latest.
days.afternoon: Lakeside lunch, then pre-booked Winery Garnet or another confirmed Godinje tasting; the driver abstains. Return to Kotor before dusk. If boats are cancelled, visit the village/winery and skip the boat.
days.evening: Last full evening in Kotor: local seafood or Njeguši cheese and prosciutto, then waterfront dinner/walk.
days.parking: Use signed Virpazar parking at the village edge; boat pier is walkable. Bags remain at the Kotor hotel.
days.cash: Carry €50–70/person in small notes for park, boat and village purchases; confirm operator rates/payment before boarding.

days.drive: Kotor → TIV · about 10–15 min; airport 7.7 km
days.morning: 08:30 breakfast in Kotor. Leave by 09:30, refuel if the rental agreement requires it, return car by 11:30, and reach the terminal no later than 12:15 for physical counter check-in.
days.afternoon: Flight departure 14:55. Keep rental paperwork and travel documents accessible.
days.parking: No sightseeing detours. Allow 30–45 minutes for car inspection and terminal transfer; follow rental provider’s return instructions.
days.cash: Keep a payment card and deposit paperwork accessible.

checks.name: Mandatory Durmitor / northern highlands
checks.detail: Black Lake and Ćurevac are scheduled on Day 3; Tara bridge is excluded.

checks.name: Two-base star-trip lodging
checks.detail: Kotor for nights 1, 4 and 5; Žabljak for nights 2 and 3. Two hotel changes.

checks.name: Daily adjusted driving ≤3.5 h
checks.detail: Both coast–Žabljak transfers cite 3 h 04 route time = 3 h 41 with +20%. A faster live route ≤2 h 55 is required; the plan cannot guarantee this constraint.

checks.name: Mountain / boat daylight margin
checks.detail: Day 3 highland activity ends by 16:00. Transfer drives must depart early and end by 16:00; weather and twilight must be checked same day. Lake boat must return ashore by 15:45.

checks.name: Luggage concealment
checks.detail: Check in/unload at Kotor before Day 1 outings, Žabljak before Day 2 excursions, and Kotor on Day 4 before exploring. Test all bags beneath parcel shelf at pickup.

checks.name: Day 6 airport radius and terminal by 12:15
checks.detail: Kotor–TIV is about 10–15 minutes; depart 09:30, return car by 11:30.

checks.name: Tara bridge closure avoided
checks.detail: Official closure is Aug 10 through Oct 26, 2026 at 12:00; this route uses Ćurevac and does not cross or depend on the bridge.

days.afternoon: 15:15–15:30 road start. Test-load all four bags below the parcel cover, drive straight to Kotor and check in/unload.
days.evening: Easy Old Town dinner and waterfront walk.
days.parking: Guarded hotel lot or marked Kotor parking after unloading.

days.drive: Local Kotor / Perast · allow ≤2 h total
days.morning: Kotor Old Town and Maritime Museum lanes; start the city walls early, subject to the municipality’s October hours and current ticket confirmation.
days.afternoon: Perast waterfront and Our Lady of the Rocks boat only if the skipper confirms October service and sea state. Return to Kotor by 16:00.
days.evening: Dinner in Kotor; book a table in advance for a quiet waterfront setting.
days.parking: Hotel parking or marked public lots; use signed Perast parking, not the narrow waterfront road.
days.cash: Carry €15/person for walls and €20/person boat allowance; confirm current prices and card acceptance.
stops: Our Lady of the Rocks pier

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Lovćen ↔ Cetinje · plan 2.5 h adjusted
days.morning: 08:00 leave Kotor for Lovćen via the serpentine. Drive in daylight, use signed viewpoints and check fog/wet-road conditions before climbing.
days.afternoon: Short Ivanova Korita marked walk; continue to Cetinje historic center and return to Kotor before 16:00. Do not add P14 or other high alpine routes.
days.evening: Montenegrin dinner: ask for kačamak, Njeguši cheese or prosciutto; return to Kotor lodging.
days.parking: Use signed Lovćen visitor parking; park at marked Cetinje public lot. Leave all luggage at Kotor hotel.
days.cash: Carry €20/person for park entry, parking and rural cafés; verify entrance charge locally.

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Virpazar · 2 h 53 adjusted round trip
days.morning: 08:00 depart for Virpazar. Take a pre-booked 10:00–12:00 boat only after confirming October operations, lake weather, return time and payment method.
days.afternoon: Lakeside lunch and optional Winery Garnet/Godinje tasting by reservation. Driver abstains. Return to Kotor before dusk; if boat service is cancelled, use the village/winery alternative.
days.evening: Dinner in Kotor; keep the evening relaxed after the lake day.
days.parking: Park in signed Virpazar parking; bags stay secured at Kotor hotel.
days.cash: Carry €50–70/person; park fee, boat prices and cash/card acceptance need operator confirmation.

days.morning: Slow breakfast, then drive to Tivat for pre-booked Regent Porto Montenegro spa access/treatment. Nonresident day access and price must be confirmed directly.
days.afternoon: Return to Kotor by 15:30; alternative is a coastal promenade and a second short Old Town visit. Keep luggage at the hotel.
days.evening: Farewell waterfront dinner in Kotor, with a reserved table and sunset walk.
days.parking: Use hotel parking in Kotor and the spa/Porto Montenegro marked or valet parking in Tivat. No bags in the car.
days.cash: Allow €100–180/person if spa access is confirmed; confirm rates and payment method.

days.morning: 08:30 breakfast. Depart 09:30, refuel if required, return car by 11:30 and reach terminal by 12:15 for 14:55 departure.
days.parking: No detours; allow 30–45 min for rental inspection and terminal transfer.
days.cash: Keep card and rental paperwork accessible.

budget.label: Lodging · 5 nights, two adults

budget.label: Rental · estate/wagon + insurance
budget.note: Five-day planning allowance. Exact midsize estate, low-excess SCDW, glass, tires/wheels, underbody/gravel and roadside cover must be quoted.

budget.label: Fuel + tolls
budget.note: North route elevation and mileage allowance; fuel prices reset weekly. Sozina €2.50 and A1 Smokovac–Mateševo €3.50 if used; neither is required by the planned Kotor–Žabljak corridor.

budget.label: Parks + boat + walls + spa
budget.note: Includes two-person park visits, Skadar boat, Kotor walls and optional spa; confirm date-specific rates and operations.

budget.label: Food & drink

budget.label: Contingency cash
budget.note: Carry €100–150 in small cash notes; reserve total also covers weather reroutes, fuel and unplanned fees.
